supersession_note: Construction audit retained as funnel Stage S0. Parallel short-run matrix tests F2/F4 factors faster than serial arms B–D without lowering GATE_A–E.
purpose: Discriminate among mutually exclusive-ish failure classes for why the first controlled affinity run plateaued at balanced_acc=0.5 with non-positive margin—without changing GATE_D, without promoting step 10, and without launching dense segmentation.
non_goals: Claiming a trained production affinity model
Changing several knobs at once in a single uncontrolled retrain

preserved_invariants.train_eval_split_of_PGT002: UNCHANGED for any diagnostic that reuses PGT002 edges
preserved_invariants.permanent_exclusions: validation_002 / batch_001 / smoke / discovery remain excluded from training

failure_classes_under_test.claim: 18 train / 6 eval edges are too few or too weakly informative for MNet to learn SAME>DIFFERENT separation under this protocol.
Learning signal exists but Adam/LR/loss weighting/step budget/init caused a plateau unrelated to label insufficiency.
Bug or mismatch in patching, channel indexing, target encoding (SAME=1/DIFF=0), or raw normalization prevents the labeled face from supervising the predicted affinity channel.
The labeled one-voxel face is not recoverable from the (20,128,128) patch / network receptive field as currently used.
MNet (as initialized from FIB-SEM-003) does not extract EM features that distinguish these faces even when construction and optimization are sound.

procedure: For every train and eval edge in the frozen supervision manifest, recompute patch origin and local (c,z,y,x).
Assert mask/target write hits exactly one voxel; assert pair_right = pair_left + e_channel.
Load checkpoint-step10 and confirm the scalar read for eval uses the same (c,z,y,x) as the supervised voxel.
Report any mismatch as CONSTRUCTION_DEFECT; else CONSTRUCTION_OK.

predeclared_outcomes.CONSTRUCTION_DEFECT: Supports F3; pause other arms until construction is fixed under a new frozen contract (do not weaken GATE_D).
predeclared_outcomes.CONSTRUCTION_OK: F3 not supported by this audit; proceed to arm B.

diagnostic_arms.changes_exactly_one_thing: Replace MNet head with a frozen-backbone linear probe on the supervised voxel feature (no dense train of MNet)
procedure: Freeze MNet backbone from init checkpoint-step2250 (and separately from failed step10) without updating weights.
Extract feature vector at the supervised local voxel (or a fixed pooled descriptor if voxel feature unavailable—document which).
Fit a linear classifier / logistic regressor ONLY on train edges; score ONLY on eval edges.
Compute margin in probability or logit space analogous to GATE_D (mean SAME − mean DIFFERENT on eval).

predeclared_outcomes.PROBE_MARGIN_POSITIVE_AND_BALANCED_GT_CO: Features contain separable signal → favors F2 (optimization/config of full train) over F5; F1 less likely as sole cause.
predeclared_outcomes.PROBE_NO_SEPARATION: Favors F1 and/or F4 and/or F5; proceed to arm C to separate scale vs architecture vs label count.
predeclared_outcomes.PROBE_SEPARATES_AT_INIT_BUT_NOT_AT_STEP1: Training may have degraded features → favors F2.

diagnostic_arms.changes_exactly_one_thing: Spatial context provided to the probe/model (patch size or local neighborhood radius), holding labels/split/threshold/GATE_D fixed
procedure: Using the same edges and split, compare linear-probe (or single frozen-config train ONLY if arm B supports F2) at the current patch vs a smaller local crop centered on the face (e.g. 20³ or 32³) vs a larger context if memory allows.
Do not change GATE_D or threshold.
Execute at most one trainable follow-up config if and only if arm A=OK and arm B indicates optimization issues—not before.

predeclared_outcomes.NO_SCALE_HELPS: F4 not supported; remaining mass on F1/F5/F2.

diagnostic_arms.changes_exactly_one_thing: Amount of supervision via nested train subsets (not new labels yet)
procedure: With construction OK and using the frozen eval set only for scoring, fit the arm-B probe on nested train subsets of size 6, 12, 18 edges (deterministic hash order).
Plot eval margin vs subset size.

If margin is flat near ≤0 across all sizes, insufficient count alone is unlikely to be the only issue in-probe; if margin rises with size toward >0, supports F1 as addressable by more production GT (new batch under existing production protocol—not validation_002).

predeclared_outcomes.MARGIN_INCREASES_WITH_N: Supports F1 → next production action is more independent production GT, not Gate D changes.
predeclared_outcomes.MARGIN_FLAT: F1 not supported as sole cause; prefer F4/F5/F2.

stop_rules: Stop and repair under a new frozen contract if A finds CONSTRUCTION_DEFECT.
Do not run dense segmentation from any diagnostic artifact.
Do not declare AFFINITY_TRAIN_*_PASS from probe results alone.
A future full retrain requires a new experiment contract citing which failure class was identified.
